Set time window

Source: R/set.R
set_time_window.Rd

Sets the time window to be used by R5.

Usage

set_time_window(r5r_network, time_window)

Arguments

r5r_network

A routable transport network created with build_network().

time_window

A number.

Value

Invisibly returns TRUE.
